notes: Reference transcription. Sources with a floor level more than 0.5 m above natural ground level. Values checked against p36. Rules A3.5.1-r1 to -r3 and A3.5.2-r1 to -r3 carry the first-four-storey values as literals (privacy.source_type is not an application fact); fifth storey and above refers to Table 2.7 (A3.5.1-r4). Register C4P2-088 to C4P2-090: Vol 2 had two columns (adjoining R50 or lower 4.5 / 6 / 7.5 m; higher than R50 3 / 4.5 / 6 m); the draft keeps one column at the former 'higher than R50' values (relaxed by 1.5 m for R50-and-lower neighbours; ToC calls it a simplification and does not say the column is deleted). C4P2-091: 5th storey and above unchanged ('Refer Table 2.7'), circular where Table 2.7 has no adjoining-boundary row. Cone of vision figures: Figures 3.5a and 3.5b replace the deleted Appendix A7.3 figures (C4P2-092); Figure 3.5b cites 'Table 3.10a'.
